thinking:
长川银行 (Changchuan Bank).
Individuals and small business owners.
Home, Personal Banking, Credit Cards, Contact/Branches.
Professional, trustworthy, ready-to-launch.
Simplified Chinese.

        *   Static website.
        *   Multiple files (at least index.html + 2 others).
        *   Relative links.
        *   Internal CSS/JS (no external loads).
        *   No placeholders (no Lorem Ipsum).
        *   No AI mentions.
        *   Design for 1440px (responsive).

    *   *Color Palette:* Navy Blue (#003366), Gold/Yellow (#C5A059), White, Light Grey. These are typical "banking" colors suggesting stability and wealth.
    *   *Layout:* Header with navigation, Hero section on Home, Grid layout for services, Footer with copyright and links.
    *   *Navigation:* Home (首页), Personal Banking (个人银行), Credit Cards (信用卡), Contact Us (联系我们).

    *   *index.html (Home):*
        *   Hero: Welcome to Changchuan Bank, "Bridging your financial future."
        *   Quick Links: Open account, Apply for loan, Credit card application.
        *   Featured Services: Savings, Small Business Loans, Asset Management.
        *   News/Updates: Latest interest rates, new branch openings.

    *   *personal.html (Personal Banking):*
        *   Savings Accounts: Basic, Premium, Youth.
        *   Loan Products: Mortgage, Consumption loans, Auto loans.
        *   Investment: Wealth management products, Fixed deposits.

    *   *cards.html (Credit Cards):*
        *   Gold Card: Cashback, Travel perks.
        *   Platinum Card: Priority lounge, Higher limits.
        *   Business Card: Corporate expense tracking, Business credit.
        *   Comparison table for features.

    *   *contact.html (Contact/Branches):*
        *   Customer Service Hotline: 95XXX.
        *   Branch Locator (Mock list of cities: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu).
        *   Contact Form (non-functional).

    *   Ensure all text is in Simplified Chinese.
    *   Avoid "Lorem Ipsum".
    *   Ensure CSS is embedded.
    *   Ensure links work relatively.

    *   *Header:* Logo (text-based), Nav links.
    *   *Footer:* Standard banking disclaimer, address, copyright.
    *   *CSS:* Modern flexbox/grid layout. Responsive breakpoints.
